expressions.cue: Clock time: 1:00. Omit any a.m./p.m. marker.
expressions.explanation: 時 marks an hour on the clock, not a duration. Learn 四時 as よじ, 七時 as しちじ and 九時 as くじ.

expressions.explanation: 半 means half past the hour. Written 四時三十分 expresses the same clock time, but the displayed 四時半 is read よじはん.

expressions.cue: Clock time: 9:15. Omit any a.m./p.m. marker.
expressions.explanation: Read the complete hour and minute expression. 九時 uses くじ.

expressions.cue: Clock time: 12:45. Omit any a.m./p.m. marker.
expressions.reading: じゅうにじよんじゅうごふん
readingAnswers: じゅうにじよんじゅうごふん
expressions.explanation: Minutes follow the clock hour. This is a time point, not twelve hours and forty-five minutes of duration.

expressions.cue: Ask what time it is (clock hour).
expressions.explanation: 何時 asks clock time; 何時間 asks a duration in hours.
